purpose: OPERATOR REFERENCE ONLY. This audit is never design DNA. The owl template is the sole source of layout and structure.
platform: SITE123 (websiteID 2670849) — hosted page builder, single-page layout
strengths: Real project photography — roughly 40 in-house job photos of completed asphalt, slate, metal and rubber roofs. That is the most valuable asset on the site and it carries straight over.
Clear brand mark and a committed brand colour (#cf1b1b) with an actual logo file available as a transparent PNG.
Full service menu is present and specific: asphalt (3-tab, architectural, slate-like), slate, metal, EPDM, torch-down, peel-and-stick, TPO, chimney flashing, skylights.
Owens Corning named as shingle supplier; Angie's List and Loc8NearMe badges displayed.
A booking form and a careers application already exist, so the client is used to taking submissions through the site.
weaknesses: Everything is one page. 13,275px of scroll, zero internal pages, nine links that are all in-page anchors. No service pages, no city pages, no about page — there is nothing for a search engine to rank against 'roof replacement Scranton' or any other commercial query.

The page renders almost entirely blank in a headless browser even after a full scroll pass. SITE123's reveal-on-scroll animations leave sections at zero opacity when the intersection observer does not fire as expected — see the screenshot. Anything that renders the page without executing that library sees an empty document.
Ten of 57 images never finish loading at all.

Exactly one tel: link on a 13,000px page, and it sits in the footer. There is no phone CTA in the hero and no sticky call button on mobile — for a trade where the conversion is a phone call, that is the single most costly defect.
The H1 is the tagline in quotation marks — '"For your Roofing and Siding"'. It names no service and no city, so the strongest on-page SEO signal is spent on a slogan.
Meta description is a duplicate of the title. Meta keywords is empty. No structured data, no LocalBusiness schema, no canonical service pages to attach schema to.

Body copy carries repeated misspellings in the service headings — 'PROFFECIONAL', 'INSTALATION', 'SATISFING', 'PROVING' for 'providing'. Set in all-caps at display size, it is the first thing a homeowner comparing three quotes reads.

No licensed / insured / bonded disclosure anywhere. In Pennsylvania, where there is no state roofing licence and HICPA registration is the only thing homeowners are told to check, its absence is a live trust gap.
No service-area content of any kind. The business address is Scranton, but no city, county or coverage radius is stated on the page.
No reviews visible. The REVIEWS section is a client-side module that renders empty — the 74 Google reviews averaging 4.6 are doing nothing for the site.
Google Business Profile lists 'Online estimates: false' while the site's whole call to action is a free estimate request.

carry_over_assets.project_photos: ~40 usable job photos under https://images.cdn-files-a.com/uploads/2670849/ — downloaded into public/img/ rather than hotlinked, since the SITE123 CDN goes away when the client cancels that plan
carry_over_assets.about_copy: The family-owned paragraph is genuine and in the client's own voice — kept, lightly copy-edited.

priority_fixes_for_new_site: Phone number in the header, in the hero, and sticky on mobile.
One page per service and one page per city, so there is something to rank and something to link to.
Server-rendered HTML — the content exists in the document whether or not any script runs.
H1 that names the service and the market: roof replacement and repair in Scranton, PA.
Surface the 4.6 / 74 Google reviews as real testimonials with reviewer names.
